note: This file lists KEY NAMES and SERVICE info only. NO raw secret values are ever stored here. Real values live in the untracked .env file. See .env.example for the full template.

api_keys.purpose: LLM API for AI-generated content (video scripts, content briefs, calendars, niche sites). Uses gpt-5.4 via https://apps.abacus.ai/v1/chat/completions
Text-to-Speech voiceover generation via tts-1 model
YouTube OAuth2 authorization - upload videos, manage thumbnails, access channel info, schedule publishes
Upload videos to Vimeo (pull-upload approach) for cross-platform distribution and Vimeo OnDemand/OTT
Upload videos to Dailymotion via password-grant OAuth (manage_videos scope) for cross-platform distribution
Cloud storage for rendered video files (MP4), thumbnails, scene images, and voiceover audio (WAV). Public URLs feed the FFmpeg render + distribution uploads.
Primary database (Prisma ORM) - all budget, income, content calendar, stream settings, video projects, platform monetization progress, users/sessions, and YouTube connection tokens
Session authentication and JWT signing for the web app (credentials provider, email allowlist)

api_calls_programmed: GET /api/videos - list all launch videos + integration/connection status
PATCH /api/videos/:id - update video metadata (title, description, tags, schedule, scene narrations)
POST /api/videos/:id/script - stream-generate the video script with AbacusAI (SSE)
POST /api/videos/:id/visuals - generate one thumbnail or scene image via AI
POST /api/videos/:id/voiceover - synthesize one scene's narration (OpenAI tts-1)
POST /api/videos/:id/render - start FFmpeg render (stills timed to narration); GET polls render status
POST /api/videos/:id/publish - upload/publish the video to YouTube
POST /api/videos/:id/distribute - cross-post to Vimeo/Dailymotion or record a manual Rumble link
GET /api/monetization - get monetization progress for all platforms
PATCH /api/monetization - update monetization metrics/status for a platform
GET /api/youtube/connect - initiate YouTube OAuth flow; DELETE disconnects
GET /api/youtube/callback - handle YouTube OAuth callback + store refresh token
GET/PUT /api/budget - read/save the $500 seed budget allocation
GET/PUT /api/income - read/save income entries (projected vs actual)
GET/POST/PATCH /api/content-calendar - manage the content calendar
GET/PUT /api/stream-settings - read/save per-stream settings
POST /api/simulator - run Monte Carlo income simulation
GET /api/crypto/prices - fetch live crypto market data (arbitrage scanner)
POST /api/generate/script - generate short-form video script (streamed)
POST /api/generate/brief - generate SEO content brief (streamed)
POST /api/generate/calendar - generate a 30-day content calendar (JSON)
POST /api/generate/designs - generate print-on-demand design ideas (streamed)
POST /api/generate/niche-site - generate a niche affiliate site structure (streamed)
POST /api/signup - register a new user (bcrypt, allowlist enforced)
POST /api/auth/login - validate credentials before Auth.js sign-in
GET/POST /api/auth/[...nextauth] - Auth.js session/callback endpoints
